current.text: He is projected as Minnesota's seventh man. He would be a bench scorer with an outside chance at a starting spot.
He is often overhyped. He is a low-usage scorer who adds little else.
Ball, Edwards, McDaniels and Gobert are set as starters. The fifth spot is open, and the newly signed Jonathan Kuminga may take it.
Minnesota's bench is thin. It has little scoring punch and no ball handlers.
With our season ending March 28, Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in our playoff weeks. That puts a two-game week in the semifinal.
Minnesota has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.

durable.text: He is an efficient shooter. He hits 41% from three with a 60% true shooting rate.
He brings almost no rebounds, assists or blocks.

note: Yahoo ranks him 199 and ESPN ranks him 292, and both value him at 0 USD. That puts him outside our 144-player auction, and the newest note calls him overhyped. Even at 20.7 minutes, ESPN projects only about 9 points, 1.2 threes and weak rebounds, assists, steals and blocks, so he only fits a team chasing threes and efficiency off the bench. Early in the season, check whether he wins the fifth starter spot over Kuminga. Also note Minnesota's two-game week in our semifinal (week 20).
